timing: Recorded before computing any revision-v3 LLM classification score; the scorer has not opened answer keys. Data preparation and baseline fitting already used their own labels as documented.
why_amendment_needed: The frozen protocol specified semantic failures fail closed, but the original scorer required every batch to succeed and did not implement terminal-failure reporting.
preserved: Original protocol, requested model, payload, planned sample set, primary repeat, inference runner, raw response and failed metadata remain unchanged. No semantic retry or manual prediction repair.
handling: Execute never-attempted planned sessions. Retain all 27 terminal outcomes. A semantically invalid batch has classification accuracy/F1/miss metrics N/A and 0 scored observations, not accuracy 0. None of its partial labels are scored. Report structural-output coverage separately.
primary: Repeat1 remains primary even when invalid. Do not replace with repeat2 or repeat3. Summaries of valid primary results state how many models are available.
contrasts: Only compare complete valid paired outcomes; every unavailable planned contrast is separately recorded with the reason.
repeats: Display all planned repetitions including N/A; ranges and pairwise disagreements use only valid repetitions and report their number. They do not create extra independent samples.
reporting: Describe this as a pre-score failure-reporting amendment, not as an originally prespecified missing-data rule.
